Example requests are dry_run_only unless a future committed approval changes the gate.
notes: H10 live-probe objects are bounded metadata observations, candidates, or previews only.
They do not grant live access, downloads, uploads, execution, acquisition, source sync, index mutation, or truth acceptance.
